coverage.note: Read from tsunami.gov, the U.S. Tsunami Warning Centers: a warning, watch or advisory (domestic messages, areas named with UGC zone codes) or a threat message (international, areas named with countries). None has a shape on this instance, so none is matched to a point: list them with `country=US`, `country=CA` or `source=tsunami`. An information statement is not an alert and is not listed.
